summary: RETEST of iteration_126 fixes. Backend: 17/17 pytest pass (new tests/test_surgeries_manage_permission.py 12 + existing test_surgeries_usuario_permissions.py 5). FIX 1 confirmed: PUT /api/surgeries/{id} with {status:'cancelado', cancellation_reason, rescheduled_to} returns 200 but status stays 'activo' and fields remain empty, for usuario, medico AND superadmin. Real cancel via POST /cancel works for superadmin only (usuario 403). FIX 2 confirmed: /auth/me manage_sala_operaciones=True for superadmin/usuario/medico, False for anestesia; view_sala_operaciones=True for all four. anestesia: GET list/detail 200; all 9 write endpoints (POST create, PUT edit, PATCH supplies-status, POST/DELETE equipment, POST/PUT/DELETE supplies, POST cancel, DELETE surgery) return 403 and data unchanged. usuario/medico/superadmin create+edit via API OK. UI: anestesia on /sala-operaciones sees list and detail but NO 'Registrar cirugía', no cancel/delete row buttons, no '+ Agregar equipo/insumo', no 'Editar' -> read-only OK. usuario UI: register button visible and dialog opens, detail -> Editar -> 'Guardar registro' toast 'Cirugía actualizada', '+ Agregar equipo' toast 'Equipo agregado', no cancel/delete buttons, zero 4xx. superadmin UI: same plus cancel/delete visible, all OK. medico_test UI could NOT be tested: in preview the 'medico' role has no 'sala_operaciones' menu (DEFAULT_MENU_CONFIG medico = pacientes, agenda, evaluacion_oftalmologica; no db.menu_configurations doc for medico) so /sala-operaciones redirects to Pacientes. Not a regression of this change; medico write capability verified via API only.

minor.issue: status/cancellation_reason/rescheduled_to are silently dropped (200 returned). Secure, but a 400/ignored-field note could be clearer. Acceptable.

administrador_igss has 'sala_operaciones' menu but no manage_sala_operaciones -> read-only in Sala de Operaciones. Previously it also lacked view_sala_operaciones in db.roles so no behavior change; confirm intended.

integration_issues.issue: Preview medico role has no sala_operaciones menu (routes/menu_config.py DEFAULT_MENU_CONFIG['medico']); page redirects to /pacientes. /app/memory/test_credentials.md claims medico has sala_operaciones menu. Medico UI create/edit therefore unverifiable in preview (API works). In production it depends on menu_configurations for medico.

action_items: Decide whether 'medico' should get 'sala_operaciones' in DEFAULT_MENU_CONFIG (or via Menu config UI); otherwise update test_credentials.md which says medico has it.
Optional: confirm administrador_igss should remain read-only in Sala de Operaciones.
